searchText: Misinforming/confusing users in the name of SEO makes me seethe with rage. This is how we ended up with fear mongering MSM. It gets clicks, and that trumps truth and journalistic integrity. <nomenclature police> 👮 👮‍♂️ 👮‍♀️ Ahem, the fulfillment of the nomenclature shift toward "consensus and execution" layers is...capricious. I happened to hear <@!552133098075193354> and <@!291925846556540928> use deprecated nomenclature on a recent podcast appearance. 🚔 </nomenclature police> (yes, i realize this sort of pedantry is why no one likes me) 😂 This is why it is critical that we get everyone switched off of ETH2 nomenclature ASAP, because changing the way people speak is *really hard*. I'm probably one of the biggest advocates against ETH2 nomenclature, and even I slip up from time to time. I'd love some feedback on "Learn DAO - retrofunding for education" https://ethresear.ch/t/retrofunding-dao-for-education/10821 I guess usage of "eth2" as a term will naturally reduce after the Merge - does it matter what average users call it until then? Yes, because people will get scammed around the merge. Also, names are very sticky, and there is no guarantee that people will stop calling it ETH2 after the merge. What kind of scam? Coinbase even has (or at least did last I checked) an ETH2 token, and people will buy ETH2 tokens on other exchanges thinking that is what they are getting when in reality they are getting some worthless piece of junk. The scam is people selling ETH2 coins to people who think there is a new blockchain coming out soon (pre merge), or just released (post merge). Oh okay. Does calling it "consensus and execution layers" help though? Users may not adopt nomenclature they dont understand The vast majority of people don't need to understand or use these terms. We just need to make it clear to users that there is not a new blockchain coming out, and not calling one tiny piece of Ethereum "ETH2" will help tremendously with that. But there are two chains right now - some users do need to know that. R u talking about This <@!301186049323958275> Yes. (╯°□°）╯︵ ┻━┻ Once its merged it will just be ETH but right now the Beaconchain is ETH 2.0 imho 😘 Both belongs to Ethereum Right One is Tradable and One is Not The beacon chain is **not** Ethereum 2. It is part of Ethereum already. Hey guys random question. Who is responsible for ethereum’s upgrades? Is it a small group of devs, as opposed to the wider community? I had this pointed question thrown at me earlier today and I didn’t know how to respond Its complicated. https://medium.com/coinmonks/how-ethereum-governance-works-71856426b63a Thanks! There should be a massive warning sign on this lmao
